structuralTool.name: LifeSpace_Tool
structuralTool.description: Query Tasks using the published LifeSpace query contract in Space "Test Space". A synthetic task used to verify metadata-driven Agent Tools. Use only when this configured operation and Space match the user's intent. Interpret local/relative dates in workflow timezone Asia/Shanghai; timed values must be absolute RFC3339 date-times. If a Tool result has error.retryable=true, correct the arguments and retry. If error.retryable=false, do not repeat the same call or guess values; follow error.nextAction.

status.description: Status (enum). Match any supplied enum value.

createdAt.gte.description: createdAt gte comparison. Use this exact LifeSpace query parameter; do not derive another suffix.

createdAt.dateStart.description: createdAt local calendar window start date (inclusive). Supply with the end-exclusive date and IANA viewing timezone.

createdAt.dateEndExclusive.description: createdAt local calendar window end date (exclusive). Supply with the start date and IANA viewing timezone.

createdAt.timezone.description: createdAt IANA viewing timezone. LifeSpace Core converts local dates to DST-safe instant boundaries.

updatedAt.gte.description: updatedAt gte comparison. Use this exact LifeSpace query parameter; do not derive another suffix.

sort.description: Ordered LifeSpace sort criteria. Default when omitted: createdAt:desc.

limit.description: Maximum records to return in this page.

cursor.description: Opaque LifeSpace cursor returned by a previous query page.
